name: Minesweeper Demo
summary:
**Minesweeper Demo is a VR version of the classic Minesweeper puzzle game played on the surface of a cube.** 

But watch your fingers. Every mistake triggers an explosion and costs you a try. With limited tries, every decision matters.

This is an early demo version. We're expanding it into a full game with more customisation options, new interactions, additional game modes, and deeper gameplay systems.

**Subscribe for the full Minesweeper experience to be released in June.**
